questions.prompt: On what date do the notes say the Lateran Pacts were signed?

questions.source_location: Final signatures of Treaty and Financial Convention: 'PIETRO Cardinale GASPARRI  BENITO MUSSOLINI'; Treaty Art. 27 'Dated in Rome this 11th day of February, 1929'.
questions.uncertainty: Britannica's quick facts list Borgongini-Duca and Boselli as 'key people'; negotiators included Francesco Pacelli (not yet sourced). Signing location (Lateran Palace) not yet sourced.

questions.prompt: On what date do the notes say Italian artillery breached the Aurelian Walls near Porta Pia?
questions.explanation: On 20 September 1870 Italian artillery opened a breach in the Aurelian Walls near Porta Pia and troops entered Rome; the papal commander signed a capitulation the same day.
questions.source_location: Treccani Dizionario di Storia (2011), 'Porta Pia, breccia di': on 20 Sept 1870 the stretch of Aurelian Walls between Porta Pia and Porta Salaria was the target of the main attack by Italian troops under Gen. R. Cadorna. After the first shots the Pope ordered papal commander H. Kanzler to limit the defence to the time needed to register the Holy See's protest; Kanzler delayed. The papal troops at Porta Pia surrendered only after an assault, as units nearest 'l'ampia breccia' (35th Bersaglieri battalion, 39th and 40th infantry) began the entry into Rome.
questions.uncertainty: Numbers differ: papal force 13,000 (Treccani Atlante) vs <16,000 (Esercito); Cadorna 50,000 (Treccani Atlante). Times differ by source (first shot 5.00-5.15; white flag ~10). Accusations over firing after the white flag are disputed (la Repubblica). Casualty numbers not sourced: do not narrate. Exact breach coordinate not sourced.

questions.prompt: What do the notes call Italy's 1871 law that granted the Pope honours but no sovereign territory?

questions.source_location: 'Contents' and 'Papal Attitude' paragraphs: unilateral domestic law, 'subject to revocation or suspension at any time'.
questions.uncertainty: Whether the Vatican palaces were granted as property or only 'use' is a nuance - check full text before narrating details.

questions.prompt: The notes say Sixtus IV built the Sistine Chapel across which years?
